clf-avc-217.text: An e-commerce company is reviewing its business support plans. AWS. They need a level of care that guarantees lower response times than 1 time for critical production failure cases (Production system down) and providing technical access 24 hours per day, 7 days per week by chat or phone to support engineers from AWS, but without the need for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) dedicated. Which support plan most economically meets these requirements?
clf-avc-217.explanation: The Business Plan provides access 24/7 to engineers by chat and phone, response time less than 1 time for out-of-air production systems and includes complete checks of Trusted Advisor, without the higher cost of a TAM which only appears on Enterprise levels.
clf-avc-217.hint: Find the intermediate support plan designed for companies that run cloud production environments and require quick phone/chat responses 24/7.
optionRationales: The Developer plan provides support in business hours by email and response time up to 12 hours for system failures, not covering chat/telephone channels 24/7 or criticality of productive environment outside the air.

The Business Plan provides access 24/7 to engineers by chat and phone, response time less than 1 time for out-of-air production systems and includes complete checks of Trusted Advisor, without the higher cost of a TAM which only appears on Enterprise levels.

The Enterprise plan meets all the technical requirements, but includes the mandatory figure of the TAM dedicated and event management, becoming a much more expensive and less economically optimized option for this scenario.
The Basic plan is free and includes only access to invoice, technical documentation and forums, without providing active technical support for logical production infrastructure problems.

clf-avc-218.text: A FinOps Engineer manages the computer costs of a startup in AWS. The team uses a dynamic mix of microservices running in instances of the Amazon EC2, container serverless AWS Fargate and performance of duties in the AWS Lambda The team wants to implement a stable long-term financial consumption commitment (e.g., $10 per hour) to obtain large discounts in all this heterogeneous computing in a flexible and automated way.?
options: Reserved fora Convertible of EC2 (Convertible RIs)
clf-avc-218.explanation: The Computers Savings Plans offer the greatest flexibility in AWS, applying automatic discounts of up to 66% about the combined consumption of independent computing of the family of instances, size, region, operating system, rental or service (EC2, Fargate and Lambda).
clf-avc-218.hint: Think of the flexible economy plan based on an hourly monetary spending commitment ($/hour) covering multiple computer services from AWS.
optionRationales: Convertible Reserved Entities reduce the costs of EC2 and allow you to switch server family, but do not extend your discount benefits automatically to serverless environments based on AWS Fargate or AWS Lambda.

The Computers Savings Plans offer the greatest flexibility in AWS, applying automatic discounts of up to 66% about the combined consumption of independent computing of the family of instances, size, region, operating system, rental or service (EC2, Fargate and Lambda).

The cases Spot offer the largest discounts in the table for using idle capacity spares, but do not involve long-term financial commitments and can be interrupted by AWS with prior warning of 2 minutes.

Capacity reserves ensure that physical hardware will be allocated to the customer in a specific AZ, but charge full values from the table on demand without granting automatic discounts on serverless services.

clf-avc-219.text: When analyzing the consolidated billing of a holding on the console of AWS, the Financial Director has noticed that the fees applied to the gigabyte of storage of the Amazon S3 the total volume of aggregate data of all the 15 the total member accounts exceeded Terabytes limits. AWS Organizations generated this economies of scale?
options: Exemption from inter-region network transfer fees
Compulsory sharing of cryptographic material of AWS KMS
clf-avc-219.explanation: Many services AWS, as the Amazon S3 and the Amazon CloudFront, have layered price structures (tiers) where unit price decreases the more you consume. Consolidated billing adds the use of all the organization's accounts to reach the cheapest discount layers faster.
clf-avc-219.hint: Focus on the concept that the AWS reduces the unit price of certain resources as the total amount consumed combined by the holding reaches massive levels.
optionRationales: Many services AWS, as the Amazon S3 and the Amazon CloudFront, have layered price structures (tiers) where unit price decreases the more you consume. Consolidated billing adds the use of all the organization's accounts to reach the cheapest discount layers faster.
The AWS KMS manage encryption keys for data protection at rest and its technical properties have no relation to the accounting of volumes or billing rates of S3.
Consolidated billing unifies corporate invoices, but does not extinguish or zero standard rates for output data transfers (Data Transfer Out) between different global regions.
Courts Spot are applied to invoices of the EC2 by idleness of raw hardware, without involvement with gigabyte billing tables stored in persistent S3.

clf-avc-220.text: A traditional financial institution has signed the support plan AWS Enterprise Support to support its critical internet banking operations. During an internal workshop, the audit management questioned what is the official figure provided by AWS within this plan to act as the dedicated primary technical consultant, in charge of proactively helping in the prevention of architectural risks, continuous optimization of costs and operational governance of the environment. Whose role is this?
clf-avc-220.explanation: The TAM (Technical Account Manager) is the dedicated technical contact point provided exclusively in the Enterprise Support (and Enterprise On-Ramp plans in a shared way) to guide the customer in best practices, proactive infrastructure reviews and operational optimizations.
clf-avc-220.hint: Look for the long-term dedicated technical expert who acts as the client's main strategic ally within the corporate support operation of AWS.
optionRationales: Solution architects assist in project designs, but do not act as dedicated advisory operating arms integrated into the day-to-day support plan for specific client Enterprise accounts.

The TAM (Technical Account Manager) is the dedicated technical contact point provided exclusively in the Enterprise Support (and Enterprise On-Ramp plans in a shared way) to guide the customer in best practices, proactive infrastructure reviews and operational optimizations.

The team of AWS Concierge specializes in assisting corporate clients in exclusive questions of billing, accounts, invoices and accounting consolidation, without providing architectural engineering consulting or logical patches.
The Trusted Advisor is an automated software tool that issues recommendations on the console; it is not a dedicated human consultant to the support team of AWS.

clf-avc-221.text: A system evaluator is modeling the budget of an application that will process batch data (batch processing) highly tolerant to hardware interruptions. Tasks run at dawn and, if a server falls, the script can be restarted the next day without any commercial impact. To get the maximum possible cost reduction (up to 90% of discount) in the instances of the Amazon EC2 for this type of idle processing, which purchase model should be adopted?
clf-avc-221.explanation: The cases Spot allow to tap the excess and idle computing capacity of the AWS with massive discounts of up to 90%. As the processing load described is tolerant of interruptions (a AWS can close the machine with warning of 2 minutes), this model is the perfect choice of economy.
clf-avc-221.hint: Focus on the purchase model that passes the massive discounts of the global hardware leftovers of AWS for applications that accept sudden fall of connections.
optionRationales: On-Demand instances charge full values from the standard table of AWS per second of use without commitments, representing the highest cost option for continuous or batch executions.

The cases Spot allow to tap the excess and idle computing capacity of the AWS with massive discounts of up to 90%. As the processing load described is tolerant of interruptions (a AWS can close the machine with warning of 2 minutes), this model is the perfect choice of economy.

The Reserved Entities offer excellent discounts in exchange for commitments of 1 or 3 years, but generate waste if the processing is sporadic and tolerant to falls, besides not reaching the ceilings of aggressive discounts of the rates Spot.
Dedicated Hosts allocate entire and isolated physical servers for customer exclusive use in order to comply with complex corporate licenses, representing the highest fixed cost option in the catalog.

clf-avc-222.text: A holding that adopts consolidated invoice by AWS Organizations has reached the corporate level of support Enterprise Support in your main paying account (Management Account). How the support plan will impact the billing and service levels of the member accounts (Linked Accounts) associated with this organization?
options: Member accounts remain restricted to the basic support plan free of charge, unless each subsidiary pays a separate individual monthly rate..
A AWS cancels consolidated billing and issues separate tax notes per member if Enterprise support is enabled.
The Technical Account Manager (TAM) takes root's passwords from all daughter accounts by removing accesses from local engineers.
Enterprise support automatically applies to all member accounts of the organisation, and support costs are calculated in aggregate based on the combined total consumption of all accounts.
clf-avc-222.explanation: In consolidated billing, when the paying account signs the Enterprise Support plan, all linked accounts gain access to the benefits of Enterprise support. Monthly support fees are calculated by applying percentages on the organization's aggregate combined expenses.
clf-avc-222.hint: Think about how the centralization of consolidated billing unifies both the calculation of fees and the distribution of contractual benefits throughout the cluster.
optionRationales: In consolidated billing, when the paying account signs the Enterprise Support plan, all linked accounts gain access to the benefits of Enterprise support. Monthly support fees are calculated by applying percentages on the organization's aggregate combined expenses.
The benefit of the Enterprise support level flows downwards to the member accounts of the consolidated billing organizational structure, eliminating the need for fractional contracting by CNPJ.
The activation of Enterprise support does not interfere with the licit structure of consolidated financial consolidation provided by the AWS Organizations.
The TAM acts in an advisory and strategic way guiding best practices, without assuming confidential credentials, control plan privileges or customer root logins.

clf-avc-223.text: A cloud analyst is reviewing the billing governance guidelines. He needs to ensure that the company's finance team receives a highly detailed gross file monthly listing each active resource in the account AWS, by extending the costs per hour based on metadata of corporate cost allocation tags for data crossover in local BI (Business Intelligence) tools. AWS issue this massive data sheet?
options: Cost and Use Reports AWS (AWS Cost and Usage Reports)
clf-avc-223.explanation: The AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR) provides the most comprehensive set of billing and usage data AWS available, generating granular reports at resource level and saved time in the S3 for fine analysis of BI.
clf-avc-223.hint: Look for the detailed report whose market acronym (CUR) represents the sovereign source of gross cost and billing data for intakes in analytical databases.
optionRationales: The AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR) provides the most comprehensive set of billing and usage data AWS available, generating granular reports at resource level and saved time in the S3 for fine analysis of BI.
Pricing Calculator creates estimated projections of user-simulated theoretical scenarios before deployment and does not issue historical spreadsheets of actual active resource billing.
The billing panel displays quick visual summaries of monthly invoices, taxes and simple bar charts, lacking the level of raw data per hour and resource metadata required by FinOps analysts.
The Trusted Advisor signals if there are instances underutilized in an advisory way, but does not act as engine generator of historical structured files of accounting of inputs.

clf-avc-224.text: A software development company hired the plan AWS Developer Support to support your engineers during testing of new tools. When facing a logical failure in a non-productive approval environment that stopped the progress of the project (System impairment), what is the maximum response time of service (SLA) guaranteed by AWS for the opening of this technical call?
options: Immediate, with automated robot intervention via AWS CodeStar.
Until 1 working time with a Technical Account Manager (TAM) dedicated local.
Until 12 working hours for open calls via corporate email.
clf-avc-224.explanation: In the Developer Support plan, the AWS provides the SLA less than 12 working hours for cases classified as 'System impairment', operating legitimate support channels in commercial hours by email.
clf-avc-224.hint: Remember that the Developer plan attends initial tests and its response SLAs operate in the standard business working hours home for non-productive problems.
optionRationales: Rapid response times of 15 minutes with corporate emergency critical channel support are restricted to mission critical business failures in Enterprise Support plans.
In the Developer Support plan, the AWS provides the SLA less than 12 working hours for cases classified as 'System impairment', operating legitimate support channels in commercial hours by email.
The Developer plan does not include SLAs of 1 time or support of dedicated local engineers such as TAMs, which are part of the scope of higher business plans.
The support of AWS uses specialized human care of engineers in rows of so-called technical licit logics and non-compulsive robotic interventions of treadmill tools.

clf-avc-225.text: A startup wants to host a critical relational database in instances of Amazon EC2 in a continuous manner by the next 3 years. FinOps team has cash capital available and wants to get the maximum possible level of contractual billing discount (up to 72%) in comparison to standard rates on demand. What configuration of the Purchase Model of the Reserved Entities of EC2 meets this financial scenario?
options: Contract of 3 years, Early Integral Payment modality (All Upfront).
Contract of 1 year, mode No Early Payment (No Upfront)).
Contract of 3 years, Instance Purchase modality Spot Scheduled.
Contract of 1 year, partial payment modality (Partial Upfront) convertible.
clf-avc-225.explanation: The largest discount in Reserved or Savings Plans is achieved by combining the highest commitment time of billing (3 years) with the advance payment option (All Upfront), where the customer assumes the risk and immobilizes the capital in advance.
clf-avc-225.hint: The discount in the cloud grows according to the size of the customer's time commitment crossed with the amount of money advanced on the first day of invoice.
optionRationales: Shorter term contracts (1 year) and without initial payments provide the lowest percentage of discounts in the reserve catalogue, violating the requirement of maximum financial gain.

The largest discount in Reserved or Savings Plans is achieved by combining the highest commitment time of billing (3 years) with the advance payment option (All Upfront), where the customer assumes the risk and immobilizes the capital in advance.
There are no fixed-term long-term contracts for 3 years linked to bodies Spot; fees Spot dynamically float based purely on momentary market idleness.
The convertible options of 1 year add flexibility for hardware exchanges, but apply higher billing rates that reduce final discount gain compared to stable fixed contracts.

clf-avc-226.text: A traditional company hired the plan AWS Business Support to support your logical operations. The financial team is facing complex problems to understand receivables in your unified credit card invoices and wants human expertise direct from a team of AWS trained to mediate accounting doubts, invoices, invoices and guide the use of corporate cost allocation tags. Which resource or team of Business Support performs this billing focused service?
options: Team AWS Concierge (AWS Concierge Support Team)
Invoicing and Accounts Support AWS (AWS Billing and Account Support)
clf-avc-226.explanation: All support plans of the AWS (including the free Basic Plan and Business Support) grant access 24/7 immediate and cost-free to Billing and Account Support team to open calls focused on resolving invoice and card doubts.
clf-avc-226.hint: The resolution of contractual problems of invoices, invoices and credit cards is of such criticality that the AWS provides this human support 24/7 free of charge for all customers of any level.
optionRationales: The team of AWS Concierge is a specialized account and billing service feature available to clients of higher corporate plans (such as Enterprise Support), not part of the standard Business plan package.

All support plans of the AWS (including the free Basic Plan and Business Support) grant access 24/7 immediate and cost-free to Billing and Account Support team to open calls focused on resolving invoice and card doubts.
There is no technical figure or position of 'TAM of Virtual Invoicing' in the operational nomenclature of teams of the support catalog of the AWS.
Pricing Calculator is a web-based tool for pre-cost theoretical simulations and does not constitute a human operating team for forensic service of active invoice collections.

clf-avc-227.text: The safety team of a health care operator set up the AWS Cost Anomaly Detection in your account AWS During the early morning, a software script in loop began to provide hundreds of instances EC2 of great size unduly, generating an anomaly of violent expenses. Which resource or integrated service allows the AWS Cost Anomaly Detection sends real-time alert notifications to logical communication channels of engineer teams (such as Slack rooms or Microsoft Teams))?
clf-avc-227.explanation: The AWS Cost Anomaly Detection integrates natively with the Amazon SNS to trigger alerts and automatic notifications of anomalies detected in real time for topics that feed emails, Webhooks, endpoints HTTPS and corporate chat tools.
clf-avc-227.hint: Think of the standard Pub/Sub messaging service of AWS used to fire and spread (push) notifications and cloud monitoring alert emails.
optionRationales: The AWS Cost Anomaly Detection integrates natively with the Amazon SNS to trigger alerts and automatic notifications of anomalies detected in real time for topics that feed emails, Webhooks, endpoints HTTPS and corporate chat tools.

The AWS Artifact acts in a purely advisory manner as repository for the download of static reports of compliance terms and regulatory audits of the infrastructure of the AWS, no active connections with logical notifications.

Pricing Calculator manages calculated projections of estimates and theoretical simulations of architectures before provisioning, without interactions with real-time monitoring of active infrastructure.
The Trusted Advisor issues static recommendations on the console against best practices of AWS, not acting as the message tool or message bar and real-time alerts of financial anomalies.

clf-avc-228.text: A FinOps analyst wants to segment and analyze the costs of the cloud to find out which specific departments are responsible for certain expenses with instances of the Amazon EC2. He activated and applied custom tags such as 'Department' and 'Environment' in logical resources. What is the next mandatory step in the financial management console of AWS to ensure that these tags begin to appear as valid filters in the reports of AWS Cost Explorer?
options: Restart the instances of the Amazon EC2 so that the hypervisor cleans the metadata and sends the data to the control plan.
Link tags to a declarative automation template using the AWS Systems Manager Automation.
Open a technical call in the critical severity classification support to request manual indexing.
explicitly enable the desired tags in the Cost Allocation Tags panel within the AWS Billing.
clf-avc-228.explanation: The tags applied in the resources do not automatically generate financial categorization. It is mandatory to access the section of 'Cost Allocation Tags' on the billing console and activate them so that the AWS start processing them as filtering dimensions in Cost Explorer and cost reports.
clf-avc-228.hint: Remember that technical infrastructure metadata need to be explicitly promoted to financial metadata before they are used for cost filters.
optionRationales: The tags applied in the resources do not automatically generate financial categorization. It is mandatory to access the section of 'Cost Allocation Tags' on the billing console and activate them so that the AWS start processing them as filtering dimensions in Cost Explorer and cost reports.
Restarting instances or moving to the virtualization layer is unnecessary and does not change the logical flow of billing and accounting of tags assigned by IAM.
Cost Allocation Tags activation is a self-service task performed directly by the customer through the billing console, without dependence on the support team.
The Systems Manager manages operational automations in server fleets, but does not have regulatory tasks on the activation of accounting dimensions in the billing console.
